# Complete Pug regression source

`hash.pug` is the complete original `views/hash.pug` from
[anders94/blockchain-demo](https://github.com/anders94/blockchain-demo).
The observed original checkout revision is
`801d7a351df32e17b3df8725e03b042036d8b4a8`; that revision metadata does not
replace byte authentication. The retained file is 718 bytes, SHA-256
`74e3997fbf665857ed76f58b5274d29ab9ed0a977ca6cf83ea93ea3b0a0aa65c`.

The original 1,095-byte MIT license is preserved unchanged in `LICENSE`,
SHA-256 `55b9fd199b9a8b9bdfe10d5fb152b378b7792c649999e934311aefdb1c9f46bf`.
The fixture is neither reduced nor normalized. Its source names and byte spans
are regression witnesses; production behavior must not depend on this repository
or fixture path.
